config.name: seed_plus_query_semantic
config.derived_query: Digital musculoskeletal (MSK) care platforms with app-guided physical therapy, wearable motion sensing, and human coaching for back, joint, and chronic pain

candidates.name: Kiio
candidates.description: Kiio fits because it is a digital MSK platform with "personalized, on-demand solution" for "musculoskeletal (MSK) issues", delivering "individualized, progressive exercise therapy" through a "mobile app" plus "24/7 digital support" and "1:1 coaching" for back, neck, knees, and hips.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK care model, similar patient population, and comparable app-guided coaching/therapy offering.

candidates.name: veiio
candidates.description: veiio fits because it helps back pain patients manage therapy with a smart shirt using "sensors that capture every movement in 3D", an "AI engine" for real-time guidance, and an "accompanying app" with step-by-step instructions and personalized corrections.
candidates.rationale: Too small and likely a niche product/vendor; not clearly comparable to Hinge Health’s scaled digital MSK care platform.

candidates.name: Upright (acquired by Dario Health)
candidates.description: Upright fits because it is a digital health company specializing in "digital therapy and musculoskeletal pain" that uses "biofeedback wearable technology" and "coaching" to prevent and treat back pain.
candidates.rationale: Direct MSK digital therapy competitor with wearable biofeedback and coaching for back pain; same buyer persona and product category.

candidates.name: Tenzr Health
candidates.description: Tenzr Health fits because it offers connected orthopedic rehab with "guided education, exercises, journaling, and wearable biofeedback" plus clinician alerts for musculoskeletal care.
candidates.rationale: Similar digital MSK/orthopedic rehab platform with wearable feedback and clinician support; same buyer persona and product category.

candidates.name: symetrify
candidates.description: symetrify fits because it is devoted to Digital Health for musculoskeletal enhancement and its "AI-driven wearable solution" supports "Chronic Low Back Pain (CLBP)" with a patient app and clinician portal.
candidates.rationale: Direct digital MSK care platform with chronic low back pain, patient app, clinician portal, and wearable support closely matches Hinge Health.

candidates.name: MUJO
candidates.description: MUJO fits because it provides "smart devices powered by the cloud" for "musculoskeletal care" with sensor-based real-time movement feedback for shoulder, hip, and spine rehabilitation.
candidates.rationale: Direct MSK rehab lookalike: sensor-based movement feedback for musculoskeletal care, similar buyer persona and product category.

candidates.name: Reflexion Health
candidates.description: Reflexion Health fits because it offers "remote physical therapy" and "broad-based solutions across the musculoskeletal continuum" with VERA, which combines "avatar coaching", "3D motion-capture technology", and licensed physical therapists.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK/remote physical therapy model for similar patients; direct lookalike to Hinge Health.

candidates.name: Injurymap
candidates.description: Injurymap fits because it is a "digital-first physiotherapy" provider for "muscle and joint problems" using an intelligent exercise software and an app to deliver MSK care.
candidates.rationale: Digital MSK/physiotherapy platform serving muscle and joint pain, closely matching Hinge Health's product category and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Genie Health South Africa
candidates.description: Genie Health South Africa fits because it provides virtual MSK rehabilitation with a "computer vision driven mobile experience", "2D and 3D motion capture technology", and a clinical monitoring team.
candidates.rationale: Same digital MSK rehabilitation model: virtual therapy, motion tracking, and clinical coaching for pain and recovery.

candidates.name: REMMA
candidates.description: REMMA fits because it is a physical therapy platform with a "Patient App with AI and Motion Tracking" and therapist tools to track progress and correct exercise form.
candidates.rationale: Same digital physical therapy/MSK care model with app-based motion tracking and therapist support; comparable buyer and customer use case.
